cohort: The study included pregnant women diagnosed with Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) at a tertiary healthcare center in Uttarakhand, India, between July 2020 and June 2022.
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) carries increased risks of gestational diabetes mellitus, pre-eclampsia, induction of labor, and adverse neonatal outcomes, which are strongly linked to maternal serum bile acid levels.
mod_finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy is associated with higher rates of induction of labor and cesarean sections.
gest_age: The average period of gestation at delivery was 37 +/- 1.2 weeks, with 25.2% experiencing preterm birth.
